clips.title: The story
paras: In the Pig and Whistle Tavern, Bartleby the Drunk faces a test set by Harry Burlguard. An aspiring Alliance warrior must take Bartleby's prized mug before Harry will teach deeper combat skills.

Harry Burlguard asks for proof of a novice's backbone before teaching deeper combat skills in the Pig and Whistle Tavern. Across the room, Bartleby nurses his drinks at the far end of the counter. Harry wants you to take the man's mug, knowing Bartleby would rather fight than surrender his ale. The challenge puts a warrior's resolve to the test.

Soldiers, laborers, and rough locals fill the Pig and Whistle, where polished manners count for little. Bartleby mocks newcomers as too prissy for a tavern scuffle instead of answering politely. The exchange leads to a brawl on the floorboards, where a warrior's training in Stormwind begins with a test of basic barroom fighting.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Yeah, I can teach you. But first I wanna see what moves you have already.
See that drunk over there at the end of the bar? Bartleby? I want you to get his mug.
Hah, and if you know Bartleby then you know he won't just give it to you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hello, fancy kid! What's a prissy thing like you doing in the Pig and Whistle? Be careful, or you might break a nail...
